name: 💥SNIPE OR DIE [FPS]
desc:
💥SNIPE OR DIE is a FPS game where everyone uses a sniper... but every round you also get a random ability to help you win the round B)

🎯Quickscope enemies
✨Unlock new snipers
🔃Use different abilities every round

❗TIP: You MUST be fully scoped in to be accurate!

CONTROLS - 
Swap To Melee/Weapon:
💻 Q
🎮 Y/△
Use Scope:
💻 Hold Right Click
🎮 LT/L2

📱Mobile Controls Are On Screen

Want to practice your aim on noob bots? make a vip server :o

This game takes inspiration from many of my favorite games :)
